subject: Azure Private Plan: EDUCloud pilot - commercial & procurement finalization
messages:
From: Alex Green <alex.green@educloud.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@educloud.com
Date: Sun, 02 Aug 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Azure Private Plan terms and SOW for EduCloud pilot

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We want to move forward with a small pilot of Redwood Inference behind an Azure Private Plan for our EduCloud Student Insights product. Procurement asked me to confirm a few items before we schedule legal review:  

- Can you share a short commercial term sheet (price, commitment, billing cadence) and a one-page SOW describing the pilot acceptance criteria?
- Data handling: we need confirmation of region (us-east), audit log retention (12 months), and whether logs are available for customer review.
- Liability / indemnity: our legal team will want to see a redlineable master SA and any DPAs.
- Microsoft co-sell: we need to ensure there's a path to co-sell approval with Microsoft so the private plan shows up for our internal procurement team. Do you have a Microsoft contact?

Timeline: procurement hopes to sign a PO by end of August if terms are straightforward. Attaching our RFP summary so you can see priorities.

Alex
Alex Green
Lead, Procurement & Vendor Ops
EduCloud

Attachment: EduCloud_RFP_summary.pdf
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@educloud.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 02 Aug 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Azure Private Plan terms and SOW for EduCloud pilot

Alex — really excited to partner on this. Quick answers up front and next steps:  

- I attached a short term sheet (commercials) and a draft SOW for the pilot (acceptance criteria + success metrics). Pricing in the term sheet is a committed private plan price for 12 months with a pilot discount.
- Data residency: we can commit to us-east region and provide audit logs; default retention is 12 months but legal may request 13 months for attestations — flagging for Laura.
- Master SA & DPA: Laura will propose redlines for the master SA; we can provide our standard DPA and accept reasonable edits.
- Microsoft co-sell: we work with Alan Wong on co-sell intake and private plan submission; I'll loop him in once commercial terms are agreed.

Can we jump on a 30-min call Wednesday (Aug 4) to walk procurement & legal through the term sheet? If that works I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0183

Attachments: RDW_Azure_PrivatePlan_TermSheet_v1.pdf; SOW_EduCloud_Pilot_v0.1.docx
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Alex Green <alex.green@educloud.com>
Cc: david_kim@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Azure Private Plan terms and SOW for EduCloud pilot

Hi Alex / Marissa —

I reviewed the term sheet and draft SOW and prepared a short redline set for the Master SA. Key items:  

1) Liability cap: we propose to cap at the greater of $2,000,000 or 2x fees paid in the prior 12 months for the pilot. Please let me know if EduCloud needs a higher cap for this engagement.
2) Indemnity: standard carve-outs for gross negligence and willful misconduct; we cannot accept open-ended unlimited indemnity.
3) Data Processing: we will provide a DPA with controller/subprocessor terms. We propose audit log retention of 13 months to satisfy certain education regulators — Marissa, you mentioned this as a possible ask.
4) Marketplace entitlements: Azure Private Plans require specific entitlement language (reseller/co-sell acknowledgements). We will add an endorsement paragraph to the SA that enables the private plan flow; however, any revenue share or co-sell terms will still need Microsoft signoff.

I attached the redline (RDW_Master_SA_Redline.docx). If EduCloud's legal has specific clauses they must include (e.g., public sector data protections), please share them and we can incorporate.

I can join the Wednesday call as well for legal Q&A.

—Laura Bennett
Head of Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: RDW_Master_SA_Redline.docx
From: Alex Green <alex.green@educloud.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@educloud.com, Alan Wong <alan.wong@microsoft.com>
Date: Thu, 06 Aug 2026 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Azure Private Plan terms and SOW for EduCloud pilot

Marissa / Laura — thanks for the quick turnaround and the redline. A few items from procurement/legal on our side:  

- We can accept the $2M liability cap for the pilot, but need confirmation in writing that the cap applies per-claim and not per-year.
- Audit logs: we prefer 18 months retention for internal records, but can accept 13 months if needed — is there flexibility on Redwood's side?
- Term: procurement prefers an 18-month initial term (pilot + follow-on), not 12. Can you confirm pricing for 18 months vs 12?
- DocuSign: we'll need the final agreement in DocuSign and an invoice to EduCorp (billing entity).

Alan — looping you in to confirm what Microsoft expects for the private plan submission and any co-sell paperwork. If there's a standard template for entitlements, please point us to it.

Thanks,
Alex Green
Lead, Procurement & Vendor Ops
EduCloud
From: david_kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@educloud.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 07 Aug 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Azure Private Plan terms and SOW for EduCloud pilot

Alex — following up on billing and invoicing:  

- Billing entity: we can invoice EduCorp (please confirm full legal name and remit address).
- Invoice cadence: monthly in arrears; payment terms Net 30 unless you propose otherwise.
- Pilot acceptance: we'll include acceptance criteria in the SOW; once acceptance is met we will switch to committed throughput for the private plan.
- DocuSign: once commercial terms are finalized we will initiate DocuSign and route to your billing contact.

Attached is a short invoice instructions doc. Happy to hop on a call if you need procurement details.

Thanks,
David Kim
Head of Customer Operations | Redwood Inference
david_kim@redwood.com

Attachment: Invoice_Instructions.pdf
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@educloud.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 09 Aug 2026 10:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Azure Private Plan terms and SOW for EduCloud pilot

Alex — great to see movement. Summary of agreed items and next steps (please confirm):  

Agreed / Pending items:
- Term: EduCloud requested 18 months; Marissa/Finance to provide 18-month pricing option. (Pending)
- Liability cap: $2,000,000 (per-claim). Laura will confirm per-claim language in the redline.
- Audit logs: we can accept 13 months retention; EduCloud asked for 18 months — Laura has flagged regulatory constraints. If EduCloud confirms 13 months is acceptable we'll proceed.
- DPA & Redlines: Laura provided redline; Alex please share any mandatory public-sector clauses if needed.
- Billing: Redwood will invoice EduCorp monthly in arrears, Net 30. David will send invoice template / remit instructions.
- Co-sell / Marketplace: Once terms are finalized we'll route the private plan submission & co-sell intake with Alan Wong at Microsoft. Marissa will loop Alan after DocuSign is initiated.

Next steps:
1) Marissa: produce 18-month commercial term sheet and updated SOW by EOD Monday (Aug 10).
2) Alex: confirm whether 13 months audit log retention is acceptable and provide EduCorp legal contact for final signature.
3) Laura/David: finalize redline and invoice instructions; we will prepare DocuSign envelope.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/27318
Proposed DocuSign (will be generated once commercials are accepted): https://www.docusign.net/agreements/0A1B2C3D4E

If all looks good I’ll push to DocuSign and then loop in Alan for co-sell onboarding.

Thanks everyone —
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
